roles.name: Product and Business
roles.description: Turn a rough idea into work a team can understand, estimate, and ship.

roles.name: Frontend Developer
roles.description: Build interfaces people can use and connect them to the services behind the product.

roles.name: Backend and API Developer
roles.description: Build APIs and integrations, or replace a backend that has outlived its original design.

roles.name: Full-stack Developer
roles.description: Take a feature from the interface through the service layer and into a working environment.

roles.name: Data, AI, and ML Practitioner
roles.description: Work with data and models, then put them inside software that solves a clear problem.

roles.name: QA and Testing
roles.description: Find the weak spots in a release and add checks that catch them before users do.

roles.name: DevOps, Platform, SRE, and Cloud
roles.description: Build Azure environments that can be deployed repeatedly and operated without constant manual repair.

roles.name: Sysadmin, IT Operations, and Support
roles.description: Automate routine administration and give support teams better tools for incident work.

roles.name: Tech Lead and Architect
roles.description: Make the technical decisions that keep a modernization or delivery effort moving in one direction.

roles.name: Security
roles.description: Review real release risks and produce enough evidence to approve, fix, or stop the release.

roles.name: Database Engineering
roles.description: Fix slow workloads and move data safely as applications and Azure environments change around them.

roles.name: Documentation and Enablement
roles.description: Write guidance that a new team member can follow without asking what the author meant.

roles.name: Mobile Development
roles.description: Build mobile workflows that still make sense when the network disappears halfway through a job.
